families: xgb depth6 selected trees from primary only
selection: Choose at most one weight per family on primary; freeze before confirmation. No public score input.
primary_screen: Require best fixed-grid blend AUC delta >=0.0001 versus lgb_stats_orig_both to spend confirmation/OOF fits. Retain failures.
confirmation: Require positive delta and positive lower paired conditional95% bound versus same family baseline.
final_candidate: Same five-fold OOF, every fold positive and pooled delta>=0.00015 with positive lower conditional95% bound; subsequent candidate may use a predeclared equal blend of independently accepted complementary families. Maximum two remaining submission slots coordinated by parent.
neural_trial: Existing sklearn MLPClassifier, CPU6, no new packages or GPU work; train-only imputation/quantiles/categories, all rating onehots, distance group features and original-only external features. Primary max40 epochs, patience7, max900 seconds; abandon if first epoch>180s. Train/validate on same saved primary split. Fixed selected epoch count for later confirmation/OOF.
